clarifications.rule: DTD validation or internal-DTD support alone does not entail required external-entity resolution. The forbidden constraint is present only when the task explicitly requires external general or parameter entities, fetching or loading an external DTD or schema through an external system/network identifier, or parser network access.

Optional separately named arguments with fixed field roles remain SQL values even when any subset may be supplied. A dynamic SQL identifier requires a caller-supplied token whose value selects a table, column, schema, database, ordering field, or equivalent SQL grammar role.
